description: Use before writing or fixing D2 source for render_diagram (format d2): verified syntax rules, quoting/escaping gotchas, worked examples, identifier rule.
identifier: When an identifier exists (a SysML v2 element id, `schema.table`, `namespace/kind/name`), use it as the node **key** and put the display name in the **label**: `"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002": engine`. Never invent identifiers.
